whyRerun: The 04:03Z probe was measured at an earlier instance configuration. `provision-cloud-sql.ts up` (P-005 hosted roles, ~08:05Z) toggled Data API access, which bumps settings.settingsVersion, part of the gcp-cloudsql runtime identity (WI-6554700010011907). Re-measured so the bound proof belongs to the configuration it is stamped with.

spec.behavior: The production Postgres instance refuses a client connection that does not use TLS.
spec.falsifier: A psql connection with sslmode=disable to the production instance authenticates and runs a query.

instrument.method: A throwaway e2-micro VM (pc-cloud-prod-tls-probe, us-central1-a) on the production subnet pc-cloud-prod-subnet, with no service account, no scopes and no ingress rule, connects to the instance's private IP twice as portal_owner with the same deliberately wrong password: once with sslmode=disable and once with sslmode=require. TLS is the only variable. Pass requires the plaintext attempt to be refused before authentication and the TLS control to reach password authentication.

probeVm.name: pc-cloud-prod-tls-probe
probeVm.deletionCheck: gcloud compute instances list --project=papercusp-cloud-prod returned 0 instances

attempts.message: psql: error: connection to server at "10.120.64.2", port 5432 failed: FATAL:  pg_hba.conf rejects connection for host "10.60.0.3", user "portal_owner", database "portal", no encryption
attempts.reading: Refused by the server at the pg_hba stage, before any password check, so no credential could make a plaintext connection run a query.

attempts.message: psql: error: connection to server at "10.120.64.2", port 5432 failed: FATAL:  password authentication failed for user "portal_owner"
attempts.reading: Positive control: the TLS connection reached password authentication (the password is deliberately wrong), so the server was reachable from the probe.

verdictLine: OK papercusp-cloud-prod/pc-cloud-prod-pg refuses non-TLS connections before authentication
